text:
andrew: kicking off onboarding intake for bluejay-14b v1 (hf:bluejay/14b). asking for perf priority + quant plan. target p99 latency goals: 250ms @ batch=1 for short outputs, but be realistic for ctx>=1024. will run fp16 baseline + int8 experiments.

kai: adding to queue, marking priority = medium (customer trial). we should run ctx sweep (256,512,1024,2048) + batch sweep [1,2,4,8,16]. include KV cache warmup and streaming perf. :white_check_mark:

devon: I'll own the bench runs. plan: 1) fp16 baseline 2) int8 static quant 3) int4 if backend supports. will do warmup=32 steps, 3 trials per config. need eval prompts for quality checks.

maria: i'll assemble prompt sets: summarization (news-200), convo (chat-100), code-gen (code-50), and hallucination tests (hall-50). add bertscore/bertscore-mean + exact-match for code. share as s3://redwood-evals/bluejay/v1/sets

andrew: perfect. devon — include tokenization sanity + padding edge cases (multi-token special tokens). also test streaming chunking for 1..8 token outputs.

benchbot: job queued -> run-7421 (owner: devon). estimated run time 3h.

devon: starting fp16 baseline now. command I'm using:

```
bench_runner \
  --model hf/bluejay-14b \
  --dtype fp16 \
  --batches 1,2,4,8,16 \
  --ctx 256,512,1024,2048 \
  --seq_out 8 \
  --warmup 32 \
  --trials 3 \
  --export csv
```

kai: + run a smaller tail-latency probe with seq_out 64 for p95/p99 sensitivity.

(devon posts quick sample output)

```
# fp16 baseline (short outputs)
BATCH 1 ctx256: qps 42, p50 24ms, p95 95ms, p99 170ms
BATCH 1 ctx1024: qps 30, p50 40ms, p95 160ms, p99 285ms
BATCH 8 ctx1024: qps 210, p50 85ms, p95 240ms, p99 420ms
```

maria: initial numbers look OK. watch p99 at ctx1024 for batch=1 — falls outside our 250ms target for some cases.

sam: int8 plan note: if int8 reduces p99 enough to meet cost targets without >1% quality drop, go for it. otherwise canary with fp16.

andrew: devon, run int8 next and attach the quality delta vs fp16 on the summarization set (bert score + exact match). include calibration with 512 samples.

devon: running int8 static + calibrate(512). will post diffs.

benchbot: run-7421 -> int8 step started.

(devon after runs)

```
# int8 (calibrated 512)
BATCH 1 ctx256: qps 55, p50 20ms, p95 80ms, p99 140ms
BATCH 1 ctx1024: qps 40, p50 35ms, p95 130ms, p99 240ms
Quality: summarization bertscore delta -0.7 (fp16 -> int8)
Code EM delta -0.4
```

kai: int8 looks promising on latency and cost. quality drop ~0.7 BERTScore isn't ideal but might be acceptable depending on customer tolerance.

maria: I'll run targeted evals on hallucination set — if hallucination increases we reject int8 for chat-facing workloads.

andrew: proposed rollout: canary 10% traffic int8, monitor quality/regressions tied to eval sets, auto-fallback to fp16 on >1% regression or error spike. config:

```
rollout:
  percent: 10
  variant: int8-calibrated-512
  fallback: fp16
  monitors:
    - bertscore-summarization
    - error-rate
    - latency-p99
```

sam: agree. also add cost delta to dashboard so PMs see unit economics.

devon: checklist before canary:
- tokenization smoke (done)
- kv-cache correctness (in progress)
- streaming chunking (done)
- quantized sampling sanity (running)
- signed-off eval diffs (waiting on maria)

kai: prioritize kv-cache and streaming — those cause production regressions most often.

maria: posting eval diffs later today. if hallucination set delta >0.5 we block.

andrew: thanks all. will update intake doc with priority=medium, canary plan, and links to runs: s3://redwood-bench/bluejay/v1/{fp16,int8}/ and to evals s3://redwood-evals/bluejay/v1/. ping me if you need GPU time bumped. :rocket:
